activity.notes: The Federal Assembly appointed Dufour commander-in-chief again on 27 December 1856 during the Neuchâtel Crisis. Mobilization and demobilization extended into January 1857, so ATLAS records this temporary command across 1856–1857.

sources.title: Guillaume Henri Dufour (1787–1875) — Swiss Armed Forces
sources.citation_text: The Swiss Armed Forces records Dufour's third appointment as head of the federal troops on 27 December 1856 during the Neuchâtel Crisis.
